fato_historico: 1890: The Meiji Constitution goes into effect in Japan, and the first Diet convenes.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may find that the structure of your life mirrors the careful precision of a new beginning. Just as historical traditions transform into modern foundations, consider how your own habits provide the architecture for your dreams. It is a good time to assemble your thoughts and build a new, harmonious framework for your personal growth.
frase_do_dia: Solid foundations are the secret to reaching the highest summits with total ease.
significado_numero: Represents the power of manifestation and the wisdom of collective action.
conselho: Align your daily routines with your highest intentions to invite serendipitous opportunities today.
